flows.description: Merges the current company into the selected company through the bound company.merge named action: the selected company receives the current company's parent company link and the current company is removed.
Converts the lead from the submitted Qualify lead answers through the bound lead.convert named action.
Creates a company and opens its detail page.
Saves the edited company and returns to its detail page.
